name: Raden Sura
bio: Sura runs two ships out of Gresik. The rice jong must leave with its fleet; he can bargain longer over the mace on his other ship, provided he can still pay for repairs.
notes: fact: Javanese carriers brought Banda nutmeg and mace to Melaka; Gresik was a north-coast Javanese trading and shipbuilding port (docs/research/commodities.md, Nutmeg; docs/research/ships-weights-currency.md, Southeast Asian Jongs)

gameplay: The Morning Star is the day-two Gresik jong with rice and salt fish. The East Wind is a different Gresik jong on day five with Banda nutmeg and mace (data/briefings/day_02_rice_before_pepper.json; data/briefings/day_05_strange_sails_at_pasai.json)

gameplay: Lose the rice jong's fleet tide and Sura will not commit the East Wind to a long unloading slot. Help him obtain Min Ye's timber without jumping the queue and he offers Salim a public bid for the mace (docs/gameplay-blueprint.md §§08–10)
